channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Shabazz Napier | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Shabazz Napier from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on Shabazz Napier
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Kenny Atkinson:

“Shabazz, I know we're gonna need him. I love him; I think he's a darn good player. I didn't give him enough minutes last night quite honestly. And I know he's gonna help us down the line.”

Kenny Atkinson on Shabazz Napier, Jan 24, 2019. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Raanan Katz on LeBron James, Shabazz Napier
item.description:
Miami Heat minority owner Raanan Katz:

“LeBron screwed us badly, we weren't prepared for his departure from the Miami Heat. We made the wrong decisions because of LeBron James—he told us to draft a point guard [Shabazz Napier] who didn't meet the expectations, but we chose him because that's what LeBron wanted.”

Raanan Katz on LeBron James, Shabazz Napier, Jan 26, 2016. Source: Bleacher Report.

item.title: Pat Riley on Shabazz Napier
item.description:
The Miami HEAT announced today that they have acquired the draft rights to guard Shabazz Napier (24th overall) from the Charlotte Hornets in exchange for the draft rights to P.J. Hairston (26th overall) and Semaj Christon (55th overall), a 2019 second-round draft choice and cash considerations.

“Shabazz Napier is a winner, he’s a two-time NCAA champion and he’s one of the elite players in college basketball,”

Pat Riley on Shabazz Napier, Jun 27, 2014. Source: NBA.com.
